Invite for Q1FY27 Conference Call at 4.30 pm IST, August 14, 2026 
 
Mumbai, July 27, 2026: Alkem Laboratories Ltd. (NSE: ALKEM, BSE: 539523, Bloomberg: 
ALKEM.IN, Reuters: ALKE.NS) will hold a conference call for investors and analysts on Friday, 
August 14, 2026, from 4:30 pm to 5:30 pm IST to discuss its Q1FY27 financial results. The call 
will follow the announcement of the Company’s Q1FY27 financial results on Friday, August 14, 
2026. 
Alkem Laboratories Ltd. will be represented on the call by: 
 
Mr. Sandeep Singh - MD 
Mr. Nitin Agrawal – CFO 
Motilal Oswal Securities Ltd. will host the call.
